item.title: Walmart will let customers use Apple Pay after holding out for more than a decade. Why it finally caved
item.description: For years, the retail giant would not support tap-to-pay—also including Google Pay—until now. Here’s what you need to know. Apple Pay is one of the most popular mobile payment methods in the world. You can use it nearly anywhere where there is a mobile payment terminal. But for well over a decade, one major retailer—Walmart—would not support Apple Pay. Now that’s changing. Here’s what you need to know....

item.title: Why is the DOJ investigating Andreessen Horowitz’s board seats?
item.description: Andreessen Horowitz has two partners sitting on the boards of companies that now compete with each other: Ben Horowitz at Databricks and Martin Casado at Fivetran. Nothing too scandalous on the surface, except the Department of Justice has reportedly been investigating the arrangement for almost a year, dusting off a 112-year-old antitrust law that’s rarely used against VCs. Board conflicts aren’t exactly new, and these companies weren’t necessarily direct competitors when a16z first invested […]...
